newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse slumps, dragged down by blue-chips.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse slumps, dragged down by blue-chips.

text.p: Shares on the Ghana Stock exchange took a tumble on Wednesday with the bourse index posting one of its steepest falls in recent months.

The bourse has been dogged by negative sentiment recently, with trading further depressed by losses in Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd, the market's heaviest weighting, which has been affected by worry over the world price of gold.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 3.67 points to close at 354.54.
A total of 148,040 shares changed hands, with bids standing at 6,424,050 against offers of 4,645,660 shares.
Ashanti fell 490 cedis to 20,510. Other blue chips that fell significantly included Ghana Commercial Bank, Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd, Standard Chartered Bank and Unilever.
On the broader market, five equities declined while four advanced.
